Divorce can certainly be justified because marriage is a free association to begin with. It is not coerced. So therefore, divorce is justifiable if people do not want to stay together.
Marriage is mutual and when it becomes one sided, the other party can called for divorce and in this case, it be justified
Sometimes people don't get along. It is best to split apart then.
Divorce can definitely be justified for many circumstances, including abuse, adultery, and other actions that completely betray your partner.
